body.citation: Shao, C., Shen, X., Long, J., Cui, Z., Chen, B., & Tan, T. (2027). Deep learning-driven synergistic engineering of PET hydrolase for post-consumer PET depolymerization. Synthetic and Systems Biotechnology, 15, 170-180. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.synbio.2026.06.003
body.title: Deep Learning-driven synergistic engineering of PET hydrolase for post-consumer PET depolymerization.
body.authors: Shao, C.; Shen, X.; Long, J.; Cui, Z.; Chen, B.; Tan, T.

protein_variants.engineering_method: site-directed mutagenesis of ThcCut1 (performed in the authors' earlier work, ref. 43; not repeated here)
protein_variants.performance: Specific activity 370 umol TPAeq h-1 mg-1 on Gf-PET film (0.5 mg/g, 70 C, 12 h); Tm 84.90 C; 63.0% conversion of pc-PET powder and 35.8% of untreated pc-PET film at 24 h.

protein_variants.engineering_method: deep-learning guided design (EITLEM-Kinetics kinetic-parameter prediction with FoldX ddG filtering), then site-directed mutagenesis
protein_variants.performance: 1.76-fold the total Gf-PET depolymerization product yield of NI; dTm +2.20 C (Tm 87.10 C).
